notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44790310/73621b8dff81df63500ea399dd84c664af943e2a.png
Hi everyone,

We’d like to inform you that the release of Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX has been slightly delayed to April 18 at 4PM PST.

We're adding the final touches and a few last-minute features to ensure the best and most polished experience possible for all of you.

We truly understand your excitement, and we apologize for this short delay. But we believe this extra time will allow us to deliver a much better game for you to enjoy.

🙏 Thank you for your patience and continued support!

With love,
The Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX Team

notes.title: Game release delayed by 1 week
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We have some important news regarding the release of our game. We are committed to providing you with the best possible experience, and during our final testing, we discovered some bugs that need to be fixed.

To ensure that everything is perfect and that you enjoy the game as much as we want you to, we have made the difficult decision to delay the release by one week. We understand that this may be disappointing, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to deliver a polished and enjoyable game.

Thank you for your support.

Sincerely,
Your Game Development Team
